title: Design: A/R Summary PDF heading 91 And Over stays on one line
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin user (the "Admin" role).
  • Make sure the report has customers with amounts in every bucket on today's date.
  • Use a desktop browser window 1440 px wide.
  • Open A/R Summary (Reports, then "A/R Aging Summary" under ACCOUNTS RECEIVABLE in the left menu).
  • If you cannot set up any of the above, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Choose "Download (PDF)" from the ⋯ menu.
  2. Open the PDF at 100% zoom and read the bucket headings, letter for letter.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The PDF downloads.

Step 2:

  • The PDF opens.
  • The bucket headings read "Current", "1-30 Days", "31-60 Days", "61-90 Days", "91 And Over", as on screen.
  • The last one, "91 And Over", is on one line, not wrapped.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "A/R and A/P Report Sorting, Export and Location Filter", Confluence 947650561, version 9 (23 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 26 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11315, story SV-11533 (Story 3, Export to PDF and CSV)

  • S3-R7: “The A/R and A/P Summary PDF and CSV head the last bucket column "91 And Over", exactly as the screen shows it; in the PDF the heading stays on one line.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.
